programme.title: Rose of Versailles
programme.desc: When Marie feels the pressure to provide Louis the XVI with an heir crushing her, Countess Polignac urges Marie to fake a pregnancy.

credits.actor: Reiko Tajima, Taro Shigaki, Miyuki Ueda

programme.title: Rose of Versailles
programme.desc: In order to help Rosalie avenge her mother, Oscar has been teaching her swordsmanship. Rosalie attends a local ball in hopes of finding the woman responsible, but instead she finds herself under the scrutiny of Countess Polignac's daughter.

credits.actor: Reiko Tajima, Taro Shigaki, Miyuki Ueda

programme.title: Rose of Versailles
programme.desc: While Oscar and André scour through records for the identity of Rosalie's birth mother, Rosalie continues to search for her mother's killer. Hearing of Rosalie from Oscar, Marie Antoinette calls on her to attend court in Versailles.

credits.actor: Reiko Tajima, Taro Shigaki, Miyuki Ueda

programme.title: Rose of Versailles
programme.desc: Oscar is injured during a fight with brigands, but Count Fersen rushes to her aid and saves her life.

credits.actor: Reiko Tajima, Taro Shigaki, Miyuki Ueda

programme.title: Rose of Versailles
programme.desc: The truth regarding Rosalie's birth mother is discovered, but the news only serves to cause Rosalie further grief.

credits.actor: Reiko Tajima, Taro Shigaki, Miyuki Ueda

programme.title: Rose of Versailles
programme.desc: Rumors of Marie and Fersen's love affair have spread like wildfire. As the gossip torments the two lovers, Oscar feels powerless to stop it.

credits.actor: Reiko Tajima, Taro Shigaki, Miyuki Ueda

programme.title: Rose of Versailles
programme.sub-title: The Black Rose Blooms at Night
programme.desc: Jeanne has had a lot of luck extorting money from Cardinal Rohan, preying on his obsession with the Queen. But as Rohan's impatience grows, Jeanne is forced to take greater risks and sparks Oscar's ire when she attempts to bribe her.

credits.actor: Reiko Tajima, Taro Shigaki, Miyuki Ueda

programme.title: Rose of Versailles
programme.desc: Marie, having just been blessed with a son, chooses to seek respite in her villa outside of court. Tensions begin to rise, as nobles feel the Queen's actions are a slight against them.

credits.actor: Reiko Tajima, Taro Shigaki, Miyuki Ueda

programme.title: Rose of Versailles
programme.desc: Jeanne's plot against the Queen has been exposed and she stands trial with her accomplices. But rather than accept punishment, Jeanne uses the trial as an opportunity to slander the Queen and Oscar.

credits.actor: Reiko Tajima, Taro Shigaki, Miyuki Ueda

programme.title: Rose of Versailles
programme.desc: Jeanne escapes prison and uses her freedom to publish scandalous memoirs regarding the Queen's indiscretions. While the whole of France drinks in the gossip, Oscar exhaustively searches for Jeanne's whereabouts.

credits.actor: Reiko Tajima, Taro Shigaki, Miyuki Ueda

programme.title: Rose of Versailles
programme.desc: Count Fersen has returned to France, having long been at war in America. When he hears the news of how much Marie's image has been damaged, he opts to help her protect her reputation. Meanwhile, Oscar struggles with her own feelings for Fersen.

credits.actor: Reiko Tajima, Taro Shigaki, Miyuki Ueda

programme.title: Rose of Versailles
programme.sub-title: A Sought Encounter with the Black Knight
programme.desc: A man known only as the "Black Knight" has been robbing the homes of the rich and affluent and giving it away to the poor.

credits.actor: Reiko Tajima, Taro Shigaki, Miyuki Ueda

programme.title: Rose of Versailles
programme.sub-title: Even if I should Lose the Light
programme.desc: Just when Oscar and André think they have the Black Knight cornered, he manages to injure André's eye in the ensuing fight and then slip away.

credits.actor: Reiko Tajima, Taro Shigaki, Miyuki Ueda

programme.title: Rose of Versailles
programme.desc: Count Fersen learns of Oscars feelings for him, but too little, too late. Oscar has already accepted that they can't be together and to further distance herself, requests permission to leave the Royal Guards.

credits.actor: Reiko Tajima, Taro Shigaki, Miyuki Ueda

programme.title: Rose of Versailles
programme.sub-title: The Doll that Began to Walk
programme.desc: After leaving the Royal Guards, Oscar enlists with the French Guards and is made the new commander of Company B.

credits.actor: Reiko Tajima, Taro Shigaki, Miyuki Ueda

programme.title: Rose of Versailles
programme.sub-title: You are the Light, I am the Shadow
programme.desc: Oscar's father, regretful for having raised his daughter as a man, now wishes to see Oscar happily married. André is distraught by the news, but has his own share of problems to contend with.

credits.actor: Reiko Tajima, Taro Shigaki, Miyuki Ueda

programme.title: Rose of Versailles
programme.sub-title: A Lilac Blooming in the Barracks
programme.desc: With acts of terrorism on the rise in France, Oscar and Company B are charged with protecting a visiting Spanish Duke. Unbeknownst to Oscar, one of the members of her unit is a traitor working with the terrorists.

credits.actor: Reiko Tajima, Taro Shigaki, Miyuki Ueda

programme.title: Rose of Versailles
programme.desc: Alain accuses Oscar of betraying her comrades when a member of Company B is sentenced to be executed. Oscar convinces the General to reverse the condemned's sentence, but as she travels to Paris to thank him, she and André are attacked by an angry mob.

credits.actor: Reiko Tajima, Taro Shigaki, Miyuki Ueda

programme.title: Rose of Versailles
programme.sub-title: The Funeral Bells Toll Amidst the Twilight
programme.desc: Facing a debt crisis, King Louis the XVI is pressured to convene the Estates-General. But a more pressing matter is on the King's mind: the failing health of his son, Louis Joseph. Louis Joseph summons Oscar to visit him one last time.

credits.actor: Reiko Tajima, Taro Shigaki, Miyuki Ueda

programme.title: Rose of Versailles
programme.desc: The Estates-General is in full swing. As support grows for the commoners' faction, the nobility and clergy begin to take drastic measures. In conflict with her own feelings on the matter, Oscar is ordered to prevent the commoner's from assembling.

credits.actor: Reiko Tajima, Taro Shigaki, Miyuki Ueda

programme.title: Rose of Versailles
programme.sub-title: Oscar, Now is the Time to Flee the Nest
programme.desc: After refusing to remove the commoner's faction from the Estates-General assembly, Oscar is found guilty of treason and her men are locked up, awaiting execution. Oscar's father, overcome with grief, takes it upon himself to deal with Oscar.

credits.actor: Reiko Tajima, Taro Shigaki, Miyuki Ueda

programme.title: Rose of Versailles
programme.desc: The Queen dispatches the Royal Guards to Paris and Versailles in an attempt to quell the growing discontent of the French people. Oscar, fearing that the French Guards will soon be ordered to fight their own countrymen, attempts to reason with the Queen.

credits.actor: Reiko Tajima, Taro Shigaki, Miyuki Ueda

programme.title: Rose of Versailles
programme.sub-title: On the Night of Their Passionate Vows
programme.desc: After finding out that André is going blind, Oscar begins to take notice of the feelings she has for him. But before Oscar has the chance to confront André, they are given orders to return to Paris and take arms against the revolutionaries.

credits.actor: Reiko Tajima, Taro Shigaki, Miyuki Ueda

programme.title: Rose of Versailles
programme.desc: Oscar and André have found comfort in each other's love, but it's a short-lived comfort. Right after returning to Paris, Oscar rallies Company B in support of the revolution.

credits.actor: Reiko Tajima, Taro Shigaki, Miyuki Ueda

programme.title: Awakening Lion
programme.desc: Xingshi, or literally “awakened lion,” is a name for the southern style of the lion dance. Historically, it evolved from a court dance in the Tang Dynasty almost 1,200 years ago. With the southward migration of the population from the central plains, lion dance culture was introduced to the south. In the Ming Dynasty around 400 years ago, xingshi appeared in Guangdong and was then widely spread throughout southern China and even overseas. Lion dance has become a very important part of Chinese culture.

programme.title: Quanzhou Nanyin: A Living Fossil in the History of Chinese Music
programme.sub-title: Quanzhou Nanyin: A Living Fossil in the History of Chinese Music
programme.desc: Nanyin, also known as “Quanzhou Nanyin,” is an ancient Han Chinese musical tradition whose singing style preserves the time-honored ethnic vocal techniques predating the Tang Dynasty, earning it the title of “a living fossil in the history of Chinese music.” The program features Yegor, a Ukrainian music enthusiast, visiting Master Su Shuyong, a Nanyin inheritor, to hear her decades-long stories of teaching this art. They also tour the Quanzhou Nanyin Troupe, where, led by its artistic director Zhuang Lifen, they learn about the basic performance formats and instruments of Nanyin. Additionally, the episode follows a post-1990s Nanyin performer, Zheng Mingming, as she sips tea with guests at sunset, reflecting on the deep-rooted role Nanyin plays in the daily lives of Quanzhou’s people.

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.1
programme.desc: Lhasa, set high on the “Roof of the World” in China’s southwest, is both the capital of Xizang Autonomous Region, and the spiritual heart of Tibetan culture. In this episode, host Tianran He ventures deep into the fabled Potala Palace, discovering ancient meditation caves, priceless relics and golden rooftops. Then, he tries his hand at Tibetan papermaking, learning how a poisonous ingredient is crucial for making paper that can survive for centuries. Finally, Tianran dons his apron and learns to make iconic Tibetan dishes, including one said to reveal your fortune!

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.2
programme.desc: Tianran He explores Lhasa’s bustling Barkhor Street, where pilgrims, locals, and visitors alike circle its ancient lanes. This multicultural district, home to sacred temples and boutique shops, becomes the backdrop as Tianran dons traditional Tibetan attire for a photoshoot. Across the city, he meets high school students dancing for Douyin — China’s version of TikTok, blending street dance with traditional Tibetan moves. Finally, Tianran travels to the birthplace of Tibetan incense, where waterwheels still power this thousand-year-old craft.

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.3
programme.desc: Join Tianran He on a high-speed train to Shigatse, gateway to the Himalayas and home to Mount Qomolangma, the world’s highest peak. As the city with the most land ports in Xizang, Shigatse serves as a key corridor to South Asia. Here, Tianran samples breakfast at a bustling local teahouse and experiences monastic life at the vast Tashilunpo Monastery. He then visits an agricultural park where tropical crops thrive against the odds of the alpine plateau, before discovering pulu — a traditional Tibetan textile now earning global acclaim.

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.4
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He travels to Shannan, the cradle of Tibetan culture. Nestled in the gentlest valley of the Yarlung Zangbo River, this is where the first Tibetan king rose to power, the first palace in Xizang was built, and many other “firsts” in Xizang’s history began. Tianran visits Yamdrok Lake, one of Xizang’s three sacred lakes, where a paragliding base is taking shape. He then learns the art of Tibetan opera, joins rangers on a mission to track the elusive Tibetan red deer, and ends the day with a rejuvenating soak in a village revitalized by hot spring tourism.

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.5
programme.desc: In this final episode, Tianran journeys to Nyingchi, known as “Xizang’s Garden.” Here, he experiences the region’s semi-pastoral way of life — feeding yaks, trying his hand at archery, and seeing how tourism is transforming lives in Lulang International Tourist Town. Travelling along National Highway 318, Tianran discovers towering millennia-old cypress trees and rafts through the vast Yani National Wetland Park, before ending the day with a unique spa treatment at a traditional Tibetan hospital.

programme.title: Aerial China II Ep.4
programme.desc: Gansu, in China's northwest, is a land dominated by tremendous forces of nature: mountain ranges flanking north and south press to form the ancient Hexi Corridor, and, of course, the mighty Yellow River. Taking off in central Gansu, gliding over farmlands past and present, behold the Loess Plateau's hidden beauty as we go on a quest for an ancient city called Dunhuang...

programme.title: Huayin Old Tunes: the Earliest Rock and Roll by the Yellow River
programme.sub-title: Huayin Old Tunes: the Earliest Rock and Roll by the Yellow River
programme.desc: Huayin Laoqiang is the name given to a traditional form of shadow puppet show. It translates as “Huayin Old Tunes,” and originated in the chanting of the boatmen working at the confluence of the Yellow, Weihe, and Luohe Rivers, close to the city of Huayin in Shaanxi Province. This chanting evolved into folk songs which, with time, were illustrated with puppet shows. The loud music, rustic instruments, and enthusiastic performances epitomize the way the local people lead their lives.

programme.title: Awakening Lion
programme.desc: Xingshi, or literally “awakened lion,” is a name for the southern style of the lion dance. Historically, it evolved from a court dance in the Tang Dynasty almost 1,200 years ago. With the southward migration of the population from the central plains, lion dance culture was introduced to the south. In the Ming Dynasty around 400 years ago, xingshi appeared in Guangdong and was then widely spread throughout southern China and even overseas. Lion dance has become a very important part of Chinese culture.

programme.title: Quanzhou Nanyin: A Living Fossil in the History of Chinese Music
programme.sub-title: Quanzhou Nanyin: A Living Fossil in the History of Chinese Music
programme.desc: Nanyin, also known as “Quanzhou Nanyin,” is an ancient Han Chinese musical tradition whose singing style preserves the time-honored ethnic vocal techniques predating the Tang Dynasty, earning it the title of “a living fossil in the history of Chinese music.” The program features Yegor, a Ukrainian music enthusiast, visiting Master Su Shuyong, a Nanyin inheritor, to hear her decades-long stories of teaching this art. They also tour the Quanzhou Nanyin Troupe, where, led by its artistic director Zhuang Lifen, they learn about the basic performance formats and instruments of Nanyin. Additionally, the episode follows a post-1990s Nanyin performer, Zheng Mingming, as she sips tea with guests at sunset, reflecting on the deep-rooted role Nanyin plays in the daily lives of Quanzhou’s people.

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.1
programme.desc: Lhasa, set high on the “Roof of the World” in China’s southwest, is both the capital of Xizang Autonomous Region, and the spiritual heart of Tibetan culture. In this episode, host Tianran He ventures deep into the fabled Potala Palace, discovering ancient meditation caves, priceless relics and golden rooftops. Then, he tries his hand at Tibetan papermaking, learning how a poisonous ingredient is crucial for making paper that can survive for centuries. Finally, Tianran dons his apron and learns to make iconic Tibetan dishes, including one said to reveal your fortune!

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.2
programme.desc: Tianran He explores Lhasa’s bustling Barkhor Street, where pilgrims, locals, and visitors alike circle its ancient lanes. This multicultural district, home to sacred temples and boutique shops, becomes the backdrop as Tianran dons traditional Tibetan attire for a photoshoot. Across the city, he meets high school students dancing for Douyin — China’s version of TikTok, blending street dance with traditional Tibetan moves. Finally, Tianran travels to the birthplace of Tibetan incense, where waterwheels still power this thousand-year-old craft.

programme.title: Golden Trail World Series 2025 Race Recaps - Episode 9 Ledro Sky Trentino Eng
programme.desc: After eight thrilling races across some of the worldâs most spectacular locations, the 2025 Golden Trail World Series (GTWS) crown is at stake at the Ledro Sky Trentino Grand Finale. It is the last battle of the season, set in a unique environment suspended between Lake Garda and the Chiese Valley, surrounded by trenches and remnants of the First World War. A technical and visually stunning race, deeply connected to its local territory, featuring a 6.9 km prologue with 500 meters of ascent and a 21 km main race with 1,600 meters of elevation gain.

programme.title: The High
programme.desc: THE HIGH is a feature length documentary film about the making of the longest high altitude foot race in the world. The film follows the path of a group of extreme runners who individually decide to take part of a dangerous running experiment gone wrong. Indian race director Rajat Chauhan works against the advice of the military, his family and friends to create a race over the two highest passes in the world (above 17 500ft). The decline begins from the start, with runners collapsing from dehydration, hypothermia, and high-altitude sickness. And by its end finds the entire race in jeopardy and the prospect that no one finishes. Brought to life by archive footage, story recreations, and interviews, the film unfolds the events in the Himalayas of Northern India and gives a unique look into the lives of the extreme marathon runners involved. Uncovering the avalanches, athletes, and the high altitude elements. THE HIGH shows the rewards of determination, the dangers of obsession, and in the end leaves you with the answer of why they called it, the toughest race on earth. Directed by Barry Walton.

programme.title: The New Fly Fisher S16 - "Bahamas"
programme.desc: Mark Melnyk reist naar Andros Island om te vliegvissen bij 4 verschillende lodges om de ultieme bonefish trip te beleven!

programme.title: The New Fly Fisher S16 - "Teton Valley Lodge (Idaho)"
programme.desc: Mark Melnyk bevindt zich in het adembenemende Yellowstone Teton Territory, waar hij vist op regenboogforel en cutthroat. Hij is te gast bij de Teton Valley Lodge.

programme.title: Buccaneers and Bones S1 - "Silver Kings"
programme.desc: De groep topvissers komt weer samen voor een week vol vissport en kameraadschap in Belize. Bill Klyn en Tom McGuane hengelen naar snoek, Lori-Ann Murphy en Zach Gilford gaan achter de gratenvis aan, en Michael Keaton en Tom Brokaw proberen tarpons en horsmakrelen te vangen.

programme.title: Buccaneers and Bones S1 - "Grey Ghosts"
programme.desc: De ploeg vissers gaat vissen rondom de wadden voor de kust van Belize op zoek naar de gratenvis. Tom Brokaw en Bill Klyn werpen hun hengel uit vanuit een boot, Tom McGuane en Yvon Chouninard beproeven hun geluk vanaf het was, en Michael Keaton en Lori-Ann Murphy gebruiken beide methoden.

programme.title: Wardens S5 - "Behind The Shed"
programme.desc: Wanneer de natuurgebieden worden opengesteld voor het verzamelen van afgeworpen geweien, staan alle Montana Wardens paraat. Meldingen van beren, poema’s en verdwaalde jagers houden hen constant bezig.

programme.title: Wardens S5 - "Fun in The Sun"
programme.desc: Jetski’s die te dicht bij boten komen? Dat kan gevaarlijk worden. En Warden Bryan Golie ondervraagt een visser in zijn zoektocht naar de waarheid.

programme.title: The Urban Huntsman S1 - "Danish Dynamite & The Boar"
programme.desc: Mette is personal trainer in een van de beste sportscholen van Kopenhagen. Ze is ook een jager. Daag het stereotype “oude witte mannen” jager imago uit, en de paradox van de jonge vrouwelijke stedeling.

programme.title: The Urban Huntsman S1 - "The Italian Hare"
programme.desc: Reis terug naar de Apennijnen in Italië en ga mee op hazenjacht – helemaal omhoog, tot boven de wolken.

programme.title: Bottom Feeders S1 - "WORLDS COLLIDE"
programme.desc: Het ruige seizoen begint de commerciële vissers te beproeven. Voor sommigen komen de kwaadheid en frustraties naar boven, terwijl anderen hun verbeelding omzetten in geld.

programme.title: Bottom Feeders S1 - "FISHING IS NOT FAIR"
programme.desc: De drang om vis te vangen – en de concurrentie – is groter dan ooit, maar vissen is allesbehalve eerlijk.

programme.title: Bottom Feeders S1 - "STORM IS BREWING"
programme.desc: Een verre natuurramp zorgt voor onzekerheid bij alle commerciële vissers in het noordelijke Midwesten. Jedd haalt een waardevolle soort binnen, maar weet niet zeker of er wel een markt voor is. Tim vecht tegen de wisselende omstandigheden in de hoop op een behoorlijke vangst.

programme.title: Fight to Survive S3 - "Nightmare Canyon - Part 1"
programme.desc: De weekendtocht van Justin en Jeremy Harris naar een afgelegen canyon in Utah wordt een nachtmerrie wanneer Justin plotseling zijn been ernstig breekt. De nacht nadert snel en de temperaturen dalen tot onder het vriespunt. Hoe zullen deze twee broers overleven?

programme.title: Fight to Survive S3 - "Nightmare Canyon - Part 2"
programme.desc: Nadat Justin Harris zijn been verbrijzeld, ergens diep in een afgelegen ravijn in Utah, is het aan zijn broer Jeremy om hulp te zoeken. Samen moeten ze door ijzige plassen water trekken en tegen rotswanden op klimmen, en worden ze gedwongen tot het uiterste.

programme.title: Fight to Survive S3 - "Under The Desert Sun"
programme.desc: Ed Rosenthal maakte een korte wandeling in Joshua Tree National Park, maar op het heetste moment van de dag raakte hij verdwaald. In een zes-daagse beproeving moet Ed overleven in snikhete temperaturen zonder voedsel of water. Hier kunnen overleven is een echt wonder.

programme.title: Dropped S8 - "Arctic Apex"
programme.desc: The top of the food chain comes into question as the Keefer brothers find themselves between a grizzly and a wolf.

programme.title: Dropped S8 - "Valley of Riches"
programme.desc: Dieren zijn overal, maar dat betekent niet dat alles gemakkelijk zal zijn.

programme.title: Dropped S8 - "Bull Run"
programme.desc: De zonsopgang brengt leven in de vallei en zet de dieren in beweging.

programme.title: The New Fly Fisher S16 - "Waterfalls Lodge (Algoma)"
programme.desc: Jenna McKeown jaagt op grote smallmouth bass met topwater vliegen in Noord-Ontario. Ze heeft geluk: er staat een massale libellenuitbraak op het punt van beginnen.

programme.title: The New Fly Fisher S16 - "Flowers River Lodge (Labrador)"
programme.desc: Labrador staat bekend om zijn grote bekenforel, maar ook om Atlantische zalm. Presentator Colin McKeown bezoekt een van de beste zalmlodges ter wereld.

programme.title: The New Fly Fisher S16 - "Ugly Bug Fly Shop (Wyoming)"
programme.desc: Mark Melnyk vaart over de beroemde North Platte River in Wyoming, te gast bij de Ugly Bug Fly Shop. Op zoek naar grote forel met sprinkhaanimitaties!

programme.title: Buccaneers and Bones S1 - "The Backcast"
programme.desc: De groep vissers vervolgt hun visweekend vanuit de El Pescador Lodge en Belize River Lodge. Tom McGuane voert een gedenkwaardig gevecht met een reusachtige tarpon, en we praten bij met hengelsportlegende Stu Apte uit Florida.

programme.title: Buccaneers and Bones S1 - "The Lateral Line"
programme.desc: De goeie vrienden Michael Keaton en Tom McGuane delen samen een boot, wat betekent dat er meer dan genoeg actie en gelach te verwachten is. Aaron Adams van het Bonefish & Tarpon Trust helpt Zach Gilford voor het eerst te dansen met een tarpon.

programme.title: Buccaneers and Bones S1 - "Rising Tides"
programme.desc: Voor de kust van Belize zet de groep vissers hun achtervolging op de gratenvis en tarpon voort. Michael Keaton en Zach Gilford vissen op tarpon, terwijl Bill Klyn en Yvon Chouinard op de gratenvis vissen. We gaan ook mee op de boot met Aaron Adams en Tom McGuane.

programme.title: Wardens S5 - "Above & Beyond"
programme.desc: Wardens zetten vaak dat stapje extra om meldingen van illegale activiteiten te onderzoeken, jagers te helpen of de rechten van landeigenaren te beschermen. Deze week levert dat een onverwachte wending op.

programme.title: Wardens S5 - "Thrill Kill"
programme.desc: In 2012 werd de kleine gemeenschap van Whitefish, Montana, opgeschrikt door de zinloze slachting van meer dan 20 herten. Wardens uit Regio 1 denken buiten de gebaande paden om deze gruweldaad te stoppen.

programme.title: Wardens S5 - "Invasive Species"
programme.desc: Het beschermen van het water in Montana tegen aquatische invasieve soorten is topprioriteit voor Montana FWP. Wanneer controleposten worden ingericht in Regio 1 en 3, ligt het aan de Wardens om het publiek bewust te maken.

programme.title: The Hunt for Monster Bass S1 - "Shallow Grass Lake Florida Bass"
programme.desc: Ott DeFoe jaagt op largemouth bass van meer dan tien pond in ondiepe grasmeren van de stroomgebieden in het zuidwesten van Florida.

programme.title: The Hunt for Monster Bass S1 - "Monster Bass in the Dead of Winter"
programme.sub-title: Monster Bass in the Dead of Winter
programme.desc: Ott DeFoe trotseert ijzige omstandigheden en bevroren hengels tijdens zijn zoektocht naar largemouth bass van meer dan tien pond in januari op Lake Chickamauga, Tennessee.

programme.title: The Hunt for Monster Bass S1 - "Largemouth of Grassy Florida"
programme.desc: Ott DeFoe jaagt op largemouth bass van dubbele cijfers in deze onaangetaste wateren vol gras.

programme.title: Police Patrol S1 - "TOWNSHIP POLICE PATROLS"
programme.desc: De stranden van Rio de Janeiro trekken toeristen, maar achter het plaatje van een ansichtkaart gaat een hardere realiteit schuil: favela's die worden geregeerd door drugsbendes. Om deze gebieden terug te winnen, heeft de regering BOPE ingezet, een elite-politie-eenheid die sinds 2008 de strijd op straat aangaat.

programme.title: Police Patrol S1 - "NARCOTRAFFIC POLICE PATROLS"
programme.desc: Als een van 's werelds grootste cocaïneproducenten is Peru een magneet voor internationale drugskartels. Om de handel bij de bron te bestrijden, werd de elite-antidrugseenheid Sinchi opgericht, die de strijd tot diep in het hart van de productiegebieden voert.

programme.title: Police Patrol S1 - "TOURIST POLICE PATROLS"
programme.desc: Met een van de hoogste moordcijfers ter wereld telt Acapulco 104 moorden per 100.000 inwoners. In deze dodelijke omgeving zet een speciale anti-misdaadeenheid dagelijks hun leven op het spel om te voorkomen dat de stad in chaos vervalt.

programme.title: Fight to Survive S3 - "Tree Stand Nightmare"
programme.desc: Wanneer de boogschutter Dr. Joe Baumgardner op pad gaat om zijn boomhutten te onderhouden, valt hij tweeëntwintig meter naar beneden en verbrijzeld daarbij zijn been, terwijl hij mijlen verwijderd is van hulp in de diepe bossen van Mississippi.

programme.title: Fight to Survive S3 - "Crushed By A Boulder - Part 1"
programme.desc: Tijdens zijn solobeklimming van Mt. Goddard, een afgelegen bergtop in de Californische Sierra, wordt Gregg Hein's been verbrijzeld door een rotsblok. Gregg stort hij naar beneden, maar kan zijn val gelukkig net op tijd stoppen. Nu moet hij zien te overleven met een afschuwelijke samengestelde breuk.

programme.title: Fight to Survive S3 - "Crushed By A Boulder - Part 2"
programme.desc: Nadat zijn been is verbrijzeld door een rotsblok, strandt Gregg Hein op een bergtop in de Sierra met een geïnfecteerde breuk. Gregg weet dat hij pas over enkele dagen als vermist zal worden opgegeven en probeert van de berg af te kruipen en zichzelf te redden.

programme.title: Dropped S8 - "Stay or Go"

programme.title: Documentary
programme.desc: RT's documentaries give a varied and unique view on different aspects of life worldwide. They expose outdated myths and stereotypes, reveal intriguing history and geography, showcase varied wildlife and exquisite cuisines, introduce you to vibrant nightlife and curious customs. Original footage of historical events and sharp analysis of contemporary politics will give you a deeper understanding of what made history take this or that turn. RT's documentaries go beyond the bare facts, thoroughly investigating the issues and giving the viewer a chance to see below the surface.

programme.title: Sanchez Effect
programme.sub-title: ‘Iran, Venezuela, and Greenland have what Trump wants’ – retired US Air Force Command chief master sergeant
programme.desc: Sanchez Effect is a journalistic rebellion. RT’s flagship program is led by Rick Sanchez, the Emmy and Peabody Award-winning newsman who’s made a career out of defying the status quo. “When only one side of a story is permitted, that’s when I push harder. If Moscow is deemed off-limits, it’s precisely where I want to be. Because more often than not, truth resides in the places we’re told not to look.”

programme.title: Life At The Limits

programme.title: Thing Is Missing
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: Crisis In The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: Lurch And His Harpsicord
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: Morticia, The Breadwinner
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: My Son, The Chimp
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: Morticia's Favorite Charity
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: Progress And The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: Uncle Fester's Toupee
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: Lurch, The Teenage Idol
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Winning Of Morticia Addams
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: My Fair Cousin Itt
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: Morticia's Romance (Part 1)
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: Morticia's Romance (Part 2)
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: Morticia Meets Royalty
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: Gomez, The People's Choice
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: Cousin Itt's Problem
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: Halloween, Addams Style
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: Morticia, The Writer
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: Morticia, The Sculptress
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: Gomez, The Reluctant Lover
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: Feud In The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: Gomez, The Cat Burglar
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: Portrait Of Gomez
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: Morticia's Dilemma
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: Christmas With The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: Uncle Fester, Tycoon
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: Morticia & Gomez Vs. Fester & Grandmama
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: Fester Goes On A Diet
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Great Treasure Hunt
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: Ophelia Finds Romance
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: Pugsley's Allowance
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: Happy Birthday, Grandma Frump
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: Morticia, The Decorator
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: Ophelia Visits Morticia
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: Addams Cum Laude
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: Cat Addams
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: Lurch's Little Helper
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Policy
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: Lurch's Grand Romance
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: Ophelia's Career
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family Goes To School
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: Morticia And The Psychiatrist
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: Fester's Punctured Romance
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: Gomez, The Politician
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family Tree
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: Morticia Joins The Ladies League
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: Halloween With The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: Pythons and the Exotic Pet Trade
programme.desc: For those of us that long to escape the rat race the pull of the wild can be strong. Whether we're risking our lives with extreme sports, following our animal passions or just taking a walk on the wild side, the natural world calls to us. What's more, the power of nature tests our limits, opens our eyes and heals our hearts in equal measure. So why try to resist such a beautiful, exciting and enlightening siren song? Perhaps there's nothing better for us humans than to follow the pull of the wild.

programme.title: Animal Record Breakers
programme.desc: We love to measure aspects of life at its extremes. The biggest, the tallest, even the rarest – some of the most iconic creatures in the natural world. Many are familiar but it's also important to recognise some of the more surprising record breakers.

programme.title: Crocodile Kingdom
programme.desc: The crocodile is king of the wetland a tone of cold blooded monster with the most terrifying bite force on Earth. The product of a 100 million year ancestry, the 25 species around today are testament to the crocodile's supreme intelligence and adaptability.

programme.title: Hidden Japan
programme.desc: Japan is the fourth largest island nation in the world and the second most populous. The culture of Japan is incredible, but even this is overshadowed by nature's beauty. There are more than 130 mammals and an astonishing 600 bird species dwelling in Japan's 6,852 islands. This island chain is so long that it spans several climate zones, providing a huge range of habitat for wildlife. Look beyond the ancient temples and glass skyscrapers and volcanos loom, bears hunt and birds do battle. This is the hidden Japan.
